sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

content.thinking:
Generate a fun animated SVG file. Let's create a cute anteater on a unicycle juggling bottles, using SMIL animations: wheel rotation, pedal rotation, body swaying, bottles arcing along a path, and maybe a tongue too. Write the file to the current directory.

Design: viewBox 0 0 600 500. Ground line. Unicycle wheel center at (300, 380), radius 55, rotating spokes. Frame extending upward to the saddle at (300, 260). Anteater body sitting on the saddle: body ellipse, long snout, small ears, tail, arms extended for juggling. Bottles: three bottles animated along a juggling cascade path using animateMotion with rotation.

Anteater: brown body, cream-colored belly, diagonal black stripe, long snout pointing left, bushy tail. Arms up. Bottle: green glass shape drawn inside a group with origin at the center, animateMotion along a looping path.

Juggling cascade with 3 bottles: each bottle follows an arc path between two hand positions. For example, hands at (220,190) and (360,190). Path: M 220 190 Q 290 60 360 190 Q 350 210 340 190 ... more simply: each bottle moves along a path "M220,200 Q290,70 360,200 Q330,230 220,200" — hmm, the cascade is a figure-eight pattern. A simpler standard: each item loops "M 230 190 C 230 60, 370 60, 370 190 C 370 240, 230 240, 230 190", offset in time by duration/3. Rotate the bottle during motion: an additive animateTransform rotation 0->360.

Wheel rotation: a group of spokes with animateTransform rotate 0 300 380 -> 360 300 380 dur 1s. Pedals: crank rotates, feet follow? Keep feet mostly static while pedals rotate under them — acceptable stylization. Can animate legs slightly. Keep it simple: rotate the crank with pedals; animate feet with small circular animateMotion along a small circle matching the crank.

Body sway: translate y ±4 on the anteater group, dur 1s.

Tail sway rotation. Tongue occasionally flicks out: animate the path's d or scale.

Background: sky gradient, sun, scrolling ground stripes suggesting movement. Wheel stays in place; dashed ground scrolls with animate stroke-dashoffset.

Let's write the coordinates.

viewBox 0 0 600 520. Ground y=445. Wheel center (300,385) r=58 => bottom 443. Tire circle stroke width 10 dark. Spokes: lines from center. Hub circle r6.

Frame: line from (300,385) to (300,285); fork. Saddle at (300,278): rounded rectangle x278 y270 w44 h12.

Crank center (300,385), pedal arms length 26. Pedal group rotation animation dur 1s. Pedals at (300±26? vertical) — draw cranks as lines from center to (300,359) and (300,411), with rectangles for pedals at the ends; counter-rotate the pedals to keep them horizontal: nested animateTransform rotate 360->0 with the same dur around the pedal center. More simply: pedals as circles.

Anteater sits on the saddle: body ellipse center (300,235) rx 45 ry 42? Head extends left with the long snout. Body: ellipse cx=305 cy=230 rx=48 ry=45, fill #8a5a3b. Head: circle at (262,190) r 26; snout: tapering path from head to tip (175,205). Long snout slightly downward. Eye at (255,182). Small ear at (272,168). Black stripe: anteaters have a diagonal black band with white edging from chest over the shoulder. Add a path across the body.

Tail: big and bushy behind on the right side: path flowing back from (345,255) to (420,300), fill darker brown, with sway rotation around (345,250).

Arms: front paws raised up to juggling positions (235,165) and (350,160)? Hands where bottles are caught: set hand points at (230,175) and (360,175). Arms as stroke paths, round caps, width 12.

Legs: from bottom of body (290,265) to pedals. Pedal positions rotate; just draw bent legs to near (300,360) and (300,410) statically, with feet as ellipses; add slight leg animation? Keep static legs, and have pedals pass under the feet — okay, feet at (285,362) and (315,408)? Crank r=26: pedal positions cycle. Feet can follow with animateMotion along a small circular path: path "M 300 359 a26 26 0 1 1 -0.1 0" dur 1s, second foot begin -0.5s. Legs would need to stretch — skip realistic legs; use simple legs with foot groups animated along a circle, and legs as paths whose d animates between two states? Too complex. Compromise: draw legs to a fixed midpoint and let pedals rotate behind them — common in cartoons. Animate the feet along the crank circle, and animate the leg path's d values between the bent poses corresponding to top/bottom. Use animate attributeName="d" values="M290,262 Q280,310 300,359; M290,262 Q270,330 300,411; M290,262 Q280,310 300,359" dur 1s. Foot ellipse with animateMotion along the circle. Second leg phase-shifted by begin="-0.5s". This works with SMIL.

Bottles: define a <g id="bottle"> with a bottle shape centered at 0,0: body rect x-8 y-6 w16 h26 rx4 fill green, neck rect x-4 y-18 w8 h14, cap rect x-5 y-22 w10 h6 fill gold, highlight line. Use <use> inside the motion group. Three groups each with animateMotion dur 1.8s begin 0, -0.6, -1.2 along path M230,175 C230,60 370,60 370,175 C370,215 230,215 230,175 Z. Plus additive rotation: animateTransform type rotate values 0;360 dur 1.8s additive sum on the inner use? animateMotion is already applied; add animateTransform rotate on the <use> itself.

Actually, the path shape: thrown from left hand up and over to the right hand, then carried back across the bottom. Cascade with 3 bottles: standard 3-item paths are two arcs forming a loop; my path does that. Rotate dur same as motion dur => one spin per loop, looks good.

Anteater group sway: animateTransform translate values "0 0; 0 -5; 0 0" dur 1s. But hands move while bottle path is fixed — minor issue, fine.

Tongue: small pink line from snout tip flicking: animate opacity / scale. Use a path with animate d values, short; long; short, dur 2s, keyTimes 0;0.1;0.2... keep it simple: values with keyTimes "0;0.05;0.1;1".

Ground: line y=446, dashed with animate stroke-dashoffset from 0 to -60 dur 0.5s repeat. Plus a few pebbles/grass.

Sun and clouds drifting.

Write file anteater-unicycle.svg. Also a concise reply.

arguments.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
     viewBox="0 0 600 520" width="600" height="520" role="img"
     aria-label="An anteater riding a unicycle while juggling three bottles">
  <title>Anteater Unicycle Juggler</title>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#bfe6ff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#eaf7ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2e8b57"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#57c785"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#2e8b57"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- A bottle, centered on (0,0) -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <rect x="-9" y="-8" width="18" height="30" rx="5" fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#1d5c38" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <path d="M -9 -6 Q -9 -14 -4 -16 L -4 -24 L 4 -24 L 4 -16 Q 9 -14 9 -6 Z"
            fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#1d5c38" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="-5.5" y="-29" width="11" height="6" rx="2" fill="#e8b93c" stroke="#a67c1a" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="0" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f6efd9" opacity="0.9"/>
      <line x1="-5" y1="-4" x2="-5" y2="16" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="520" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="520" cy="70" r="34" fill="#ffd75e">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="34;37;34" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="110" cy="80" rx="42" ry="16"/>
      <ellipse cx="140" cy="70" rx="30" ry="14"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        values="0 0; 30 0; 0 0" dur="14s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="400" cy="130" rx="36" ry="13"/>
      <ellipse cx="425" cy="122" rx="24" ry="11"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        values="0 0; -40 0; 0 0" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect y="446" width="600" height="74" fill="#c9e6a4"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="446" x2="600" y2="446" stroke="#7fae57" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="470" x2="600" y2="470" stroke="#9cc873" stroke-width="5"
        stroke-dasharray="34 26">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-60" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>
  <line x1="0" y1="496" x2="600" y2="496" stroke="#9cc873" stroke-width="4"
        stroke-dasharray="20 40">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-60" dur="0.35s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>

  <!-- Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="450" rx="70" ry="9" fill="#000" opacity="0.15">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="70;62;70" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- ===== Unicycle ===== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Wheel -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="385" r="58" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="10"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="385" r="50" fill="none" stroke="#888" stroke-width="3"/>
    <g stroke="#999" stroke-width="3">
      <line x1="300" y1="335" x2="300" y2="435"/>
      <line x1="250" y1="385" x2="350" y2="385"/>
      <line x1="265" y1="350" x2="335" y2="420"/>
      <line x1="335" y1="350" x2="265" y2="420"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
        from="0 300 385" to="360 300 385" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="300" cy="385" r="7" fill="#555"/>

    <!-- Frame + saddle -->
    <line x1="300" y1="385" x2="300" y2="282" stroke="#d43d3d" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 284 300 L 300 385 L 316 300" fill="none" stroke="#d43d3d" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="274" y="270" width="52" height="13" rx="6" fill="#4a2c17"/>

    <!-- Cranks + pedals (pedals counter-rotate to stay level) -->
    <g>
      <line x1="300" y1="359" x2="300" y2="411" stroke="#444" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <g>
        <rect x="286" y="354" width="28" height="8" rx="3" fill="#222"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
          from="0 300 359" to="-360 300 359" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </g>
      <g>
        <rect x="286" y="406" width="28" height="8" rx="3" fill="#222"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
          from="0 300 411" to="-360 300 411" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
        from="0 300 385" to="360 300 385" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== Anteater (bobbing with the ride) ===== -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
      values="0 0; 0 -5; 0 0" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Legs: bend in sync with the pedals -->
    <path fill="none" stroke="#7a4a2b" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"
          d="M 292 262 Q 280 310 300 359">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="M 292 262 Q 280 310 300 359;
                M 292 262 Q 268 335 300 411;
                M 292 262 Q 280 310 300 359"/>
    </path>
    <path fill="none" stroke="#8a5a3b" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"
          d="M 310 262 Q 322 335 300 411">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="M 310 262 Q 322 335 300 411;
                M 310 262 Q 326 310 300 359;
                M 310 262 Q 322 335 300 411"/>
    </path>
    <!-- Feet ride the crank circle -->
    <ellipse rx="13" ry="7" fill="#5b3620">
      <animateMotion dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        path="M 300 359 a 26 26 0 1 1 -0.1 0"/>
    </ellipse>
    <ellipse rx="13" ry="7" fill="#6b4226">
      <animateMotion dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-0.5s"
        path="M 300 359 a 26 26 0 1 1 -0.1 0"/>
    </ellipse>

    <!-- Bushy tail -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 340 250 Q 415 240 435 300 Q 445 335 415 340 Q 430 310 400 295 Q 370 282 340 275 Z"
            fill="#5b3620"/>
      <path d="M 350 258 Q 405 258 420 300" fill="none" stroke="#7a4a2b" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
        values="-4 340 255; 5 340 255; -4 340 255" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="303" cy="228" rx="49" ry="46" fill="#8a5a3b"/>
    <ellipse cx="296" cy="245" rx="32" ry="26" fill="#c9a06e"/>
    <!-- Anteater shoulder stripe -->
    <path d="M 268 196 Q 300 214 322 268 L 338 258 Q 316 204 282 186 Z" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <path d="M 264 199 Q 297 218 318 270 L 322 268 Q 300 214 268 196 Z" fill="#f2e8d8"/>
    <path d="M 282 186 Q 316 204 338 258 L 342 254 Q 320 200 286 183 Z" fill="#f2e8d8"/>

    <!-- Head + long snout -->
    <circle cx="262" cy="188" r="27" fill="#8a5a3b"/>
    <path d="M 252 172 Q 200 178 172 202 Q 168 207 173 210 Q 205 202 258 208 Q 268 196 262 180 Z"
          fill="#8a5a3b"/>
    <path d="M 176 203 Q 210 194 250 194" fill="none" stroke="#c9a06e" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="172" cy="206" r="4.5" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
    <!-- Flicking tongue -->
    <path d="M 170 208 q -12 4 -20 2" fill="none" stroke="#e8798a" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        keyTimes="0;0.06;0.12;0.18;1"
        values="M 170 208 q -2 1 -3 1;
                M 170 208 q -16 6 -28 2;
                M 170 208 q -14 -2 -26 6;
                M 170 208 q -2 1 -3 1;
                M 170 208 q -2 1 -3 1"/>
    </path>
    <!-- Eye + ear -->
    <circle cx="252" cy="180" r="4.5" fill="#1c1c1c"/>
    <circle cx="253.5" cy="178.5" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>
    <path d="M 274 166 q 6 -12 14 -6 q -2 8 -10 10 Z" fill="#5b3620"/>
    <!-- Smile -->
    <path d="M 236 198 q 6 5 13 3" fill="none" stroke="#4a2c17" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Juggling arms (paws at the catch points) -->
    <path d="M 276 210 Q 244 200 231 178" fill="none" stroke="#8a5a3b" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="M 276 210 Q 244 200 231 178; M 276 210 Q 242 196 231 172; M 276 210 Q 244 200 231 178"/>
    </path>
    <path d="M 330 212 Q 352 198 360 178" fill="none" stroke="#7a4a2b" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="-0.3s"
        values="M 330 212 Q 352 198 360 178; M 330 212 Q 354 194 360 172; M 330 212 Q 352 198 360 178"/>
    </path>
    <circle cx="230" cy="176" r="9" fill="#5b3620"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="176" r="9" fill="#5b3620"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== Juggling bottles: 3-bottle cascade ===== -->
  <g>
    <g>
      <use xlink:href="#bottle">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
          from="0" to="360" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </use>
      <animateMotion dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        path="M 230 172 C 235 55, 365 55, 361 172 C 358 205, 233 205, 230 172 Z"/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <use xlink:href="#bottle">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
